what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Nepal in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 14564 asylum seekers from Nepal.
The United States hosts the largest share, 44.1%, followed by Canada, Australia and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Nepal with the CPN-M from 1996 to 2006, at war level in some of those years.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in Nepal in recent years, so it does not say why the number of asylum seekers grew.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 444 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 19619, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2017 and 2019 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from Nepal are counted separately.
